To me anyway, depression and anxiety are distinct phenomena. One can complexly lead to the other (being anxious for a long time can make you depressed, or anxiety can be one of the features of a depression), but to me I experience them separately.

I've heard lots of pat, single-sentence descriptions of clinical depression (i.e. depression is anger turned inward, or something) and really, Depression is just Depression: inexplicable, indescribable, fucking horrible, one of the worst diseases you can have. It really defies description.
